run_charnn_training: run the charnn GPT model training with distributed data parallel on a character dataset
generate_text_with_charnn: generate text completions from a trained charnn GPT model using a seed phrase
create_ddp_model_and_optimizer: create a DDP wrapped GPT model and AdamW optimizer from GPTConfig and OptimizerConfig
setup_distributed_process_group: setup a PyTorch distributed process group using nccl for CUDA or gloo for CPU
save_combined_module: save a CombinedModule with transform and model to a file path using fsspec
